description.zh:
网站业务的域名。N的最大值：200，即最多可查询200个网站业务的域名。
> 域名必须已配置网站业务转发规则。您可以调用[DescribeDomains](~~91724~~)查询所有域名。
description.en:
The domain names of the websites. You can specify the domain names of up to 200 websites.

> A forwarding rule must be configured for the domain name. You can call [DescribeDomains](~~91724~~) to query all domain names.

description.zh: DDoS高防实例在资源管理产品中所属的资源组ID。默认为空，即属于默认资源组。
description.en: The ID of the resource group to which the Anti-DDoS Proxy instance belongs in Resource Management. This parameter is empty by default, which indicates that the instance belongs to the default resource group.

title.zh: 查询网站业务的CNAME复用信息

descriptions.zh: 该接口仅适用于DDoS高防（非中国内地）服务。
descriptions.en: This operation is applicable only to Anti-DDoS Proxy (Outside Chinese Mainland).

example.unifiedCli: aliyun ddoscoo describe-cname-reuses --resource-group-id default --domains www.aliyun.com --api-version 2020-01-01 --region cn-hangzhou
